text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. black quilted handbag with long gold chain strap
original_prompt: Create one photorealistic wardrobe catalog product image. Pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio light, true fabric texture, portrait 2:3. No human, face, hair, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, stand or hanger. Entire object fully inside frame with generous margins. No added text, labels, watermark, border or scenery. Input image is a product design reference. From ONLY the outfit at 上排左, isolate exactly ONE accessory product (earrings or gloves may be a matched pair): black quilted handbag with long gold chain strap. Display the entire standalone object in a clear product-photo angle, centered, retain all straps, chains, ends and hardware with ample margins. No garment, person, hands or other accessory. No collage. Show one item only; for a matched pair show the pair together. Any reference occlusion: conservatively complete the same material and construction.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
